verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair privacy-posture question for a CRM, so the axis applies. The pack documents no retention policies, data-purge settings, or account or data deletion controls. The generic CRUD REST API (docs-1) is a developer building block for deleting individual records, not a retention or deletion control, and notification-channel expiry and data export are adjacent features that earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
